standard_prerequisites.name: Stalks commute with tensor products

standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that applying p^{-1} to a tensor product of modules gives the tensor product of the stalks.

standard_prerequisites.name: Stalks of pullbacks under a morphism of sites/topoi
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Sites, Lemmas sites-lemma-point-morphism-sites and sites-lemma-point-morphism-topoi
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the identification of the stalk of f^{-1}\mathcal{F} at p with the stalk of \mathcal{F} at q.

core_obligations: Write f^*\mathcal{F} = f^{-1}\mathcal{F} \otimes_{f^{-1}\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{D}} \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{C} by the definition of the pullback of modules of ringed topoi or ringed sites (proof lines 7204-7209).
Take stalks at p and use that p^{-1} commutes with \otimes via lemma-tensor-product-pullback (proof lines 7210-7212).

Identify the stalk of f^{-1}\mathcal{F} at p with the stalk of \mathcal{F} at q = f \circ p via the relation explained in the cited Sites lemmas on points of morphisms, concluding the displayed tensor formula (proof lines 7213-7216).
proof_roadmap: Unfold f^*\mathcal{F} as the tensor of f^{-1}\mathcal{F} with \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{C}.
Commute stalks with the tensor product.
Transport the stalk along the point map p \mapsto q = f \circ p and conclude.
difficulty_reason: The proof unfolds the definition of the pullback of modules (tensor of the inverse image with the structure sheaf), then transports the question to stalks using two standard commutation facts: taking stalks at p (applying p^{-1}) commutes with tensor product (lemma-tensor-product-pullback of this chapter), and the stalk of a pullback at p agrees with the stalk at the image point q = f \circ p (Sites lemmas on points of morphisms of sites and topoi). Assembling these into the displayed identification is the substance; each ingredient is explicitly invoked in the proof lines.
